description: ⚠️ Destructive: Cancel a scheduled SMS request before it is sent (DELETE /sms/v2/services/{serviceId}/reservations/{reserveId} → 204). Set confirm=true to execute.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

reserveId.description: Reservation ID (requestId of the scheduled send)

serviceId.description: SMS service ID in NRN form (e.g. ncp:sms:kr:1********2:myproject). Defaults to NCLOUD_SENS_SMS_SERVICE_ID / NCLOUD_SENS_SERVICE_ID. Find it with ncloud_sens_list_projects (smsService.serviceId). A 'Forbidden' reply means the project does not have this channel enabled.

name: ncloud_sens_cancel_sms_reservation
